en:
This place is huge! I hope we can find
all the things we're looking for.

Ah, don't worry, I know where
the cameras and sensors are...
I'll go get them. You can wait here.
Oh, are you sure?

<CLT=cltMIND>After he said that, Shuichi walked to the
back of the warehouse.

I know where the cameras and sensors are.
I'll go get them, you can wait here.
<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll wait for Shuichi then...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
Sensor

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a wooden box...

Are these...iron balls? They look like they're
for shot put...

<CLT=cltMIND>I picked one up to see if it was as heavy
as it looked...and it was.

<CLT=cltMIND>The athletes who have to hurl these things
are pretty impressive...
...Kaede? What are you doing?
Oh, Shuichi. Done already?

Yeah, I've got the cameras.
I think three should be enough.
Disposable cameras? Will these work?

That's all they had.
But they work, it should be fine.

There's also photo developing solution here,
so we don't have to worry about that.
Well, if you're fine with them...
Yeah... Three cameras should be okay.
Also, here's a security sensor...
When this sensor picks up <CLT=cltSTRONG>movement<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
it triggers this receiver to make a <CLT=cltSTRONG>sound<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
We should get three of these as well...

As huge as this warehouse is, I didn't expect
it to have security sensors in stock.

Oh, do you want me to carry the cameras?
I can put them in my backpack.

I only have my music sheets and a spare
vest, so there's still lots of room inside.

Alright...
Let's go talk to Miu.

<CLT=cltMIND>As I took the three disposable cameras
from Shuichi—
<CLT=cltMIND>I suddenly stopped.
<CLT=cltMIND>Will these cameras really work?

<CLT=cltMIND>Even if we take pictures of the mastermind
and persuade everyone...
<CLT=cltMIND>What will we do after that?

<CLT=cltMIND>The mastermind could just smirk and order
the Exisals to attack everyone.

<CLT=cltMIND>Can we really protect everyone with this plan?
Will we really be able to escape this place?

...Kaede? Is something wrong...?
We need to go, before Miu changes her mind.

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi was already at the door of the
warehouse, waiting for me.
...Oh, sorry!

<CLT=cltMIND>I shoved the things I was holding 
into my backpack, and ran after him.

<CLT=cltMIND>A remote-controlled helicopter...
What's this doing in a school warehouse?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a high-jump bar. Cool, I guess...

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't matter, though.
Because we're getting out of this place.

<CLT=cltMIND>A gym mat has been placed here.
It's probably for P.E. classes or something...

<CLT=cltMIND>But we haven't had a single P.E. class yet,
so I'm not sure if we'll ever use this.

<CLT=cltMIND>Track and field hurdles... I guess it's not
weird for a school to have these.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we won't be attending classes here.
We're getting out of this place!
Disposable Camera
Photographic Developer
